name: @univarse/stack
description: The local production-like stack (spec 0019, ADR-030): secrets and certificates (stack:init), the verified deploy (stack:deploy), Vault (stack:vault), the smoke check, the edge CA's trust step (stack:trust), PgBouncer's pools (stack:pools), and the E2E and isolation runs over a temporary loopback tunnel (stack:e2e, stack:isolation), and the shred ledger with its destruction protocol (stack:keys, spec 0020) and its bucket copy's check (stack:bucket-check). Runs the verified images by digest only.
